info.title: API Reference
info.description:
# Overview The Kaseya Quote Manager API lets you build apps and integrations that extend and enhance Kaseya Quote Manager. Our API utilizes the [REST](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_state_transfer) architecture, has predictable resource-oriented URLs, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs. All endpoints are read-only and cover all the core Kaseya Quote Manager features. All API requests must be made over [HTTPS](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTPS). Calls made over plain HTTP will fail. API requests without authentication will also fail. # Authentication Authentication to the API is performed via api keys. Provide your API key as a Header parameter named `apiKey`. You do not need to provide a password. API Keys can be managed in your Kaseya Quote Manager portal via your account menu in the top right. To keep your data secure, do not share your secret API keys in publicly accessible areas such as GitHub, client-side code, forums, and so on. ![Location of Developer API Menu](/img/developer-api-access-screenshot.png) # Pagination All API resources support bulk fetches via "list" API methods. For instance, you can list customers, list products, and list quotes. To utilise paging you must append a `page` and `pageSize` parameter to the URL. If there are 100 records in the response you will need to check if there is any more data by fetching the next page e.g ?page=2 and continuing this process until no more results are returned. ```javascript https://api.kaseyaquotemanager.com/v1/customer?page=1&pagesize=100 ``` `pageSize` has a maximum allowed value of 100, larger values are treated as 100. If this value is missing, pageSize typically defaults to 100. # Rate Limits There are limits to the number of API calls that your application can make against the Kaseya Quote Manager API: - Minute Limit: 60 requests per minute - Daily Limit: 10,000 requests day Exceeding a rate limit will result in an HTTP 429 (too many requests) response. A basic technique for integrations to gracefully handle rate limiting is to watch for 429 status codes and build in a retry mechanism. The retry mechanism should follow an exponential backoff schedule to reduce request volume when necessary. We’d also recommend building some randomness into the backoff schedule to avoid a [thundering herd effect](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Thundering_herd_problem). # Errors Responses from the Kaseya Quote Manager API use standard HTTP response codes to indicate the success of failure of an API request. ---

200 OK

Successful API call. A JSON object or JSON array of objects will be returned. ---

400 Bad Request

The requested resource does not exist. Typically this is due to an invalid ID being provided. ---

401 Unauthorized

The API Key provided is not valid. ---

429 Too Many Requests

Too many requests were received by the API in a short timespan. We recommend an exponential backoff of your requests. ---

5xx Errors

An internal error occurred in Kaseya Quote Manager. Contact support for assistance. ---

get.description: Gets a list of `Brand` objects with optional filtering for brands modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Contact` objects with optional filtering for only those contacts that belong to a specific `Customer` and for contacts modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Customer` objects with optional filtering for only those customers modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of customer addresses
get.description: Gets a list of `CustomerAddress` objects with optional filtering for only those customer addresses that belong to a specific `Customer` and for customer addresses modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Product` objects with optional filtering for only those products that match a specific manufacturer's part numer and for products modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of products images
get.description: Gets a list of `ProductImage` objects with optional filtering for only those product images of a specific `Product` by identifier.

get.summary: Get a list of product suppliers
get.description: Gets a list of `ProductSupplier` objects with optional filtering for only those product suppliers that belong to a specific `Product` identifier and for product suppliers modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of purchase orders
get.description: Gets a list of `PurchaseOrder` objects with optional filtering for purchase orders that match a specified `OrderNumber` and purchase orders that were modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of purchase order costs
get.description: Gets a list of `PurchaseOrderCost` objects with optional filtering for only those purchase order costs that belong to a specific `PurchaseOrder` by identifier and for purchase order costs modified after a specified date.

200.description: Returns an array of purchase order costs.

get.summary: Get a list of purchase order lines
get.description: Gets a list of `PurchaseOrderLine` objects with optional filtering for only those purchase order lines that belong to a specific `PurchaseOrder` by identifier and for purchase order lines modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Quote` objects with optional filtering for quotes that match a specified `QuoteNumber` and quotes that were modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of quote lines
get.description: Gets a list of `QuoteLine` objects with optional filtering for only those quote lines that belong to a specific `QuoteSection` by identifier.

get.summary: Get a list of quote sections
get.description: Gets a list of `QuoteSection` objects with optional filtering for only those quote sections that belong to a specific `Quote` by identifier.

get.summary: Get a list of sales orders
get.description: Gets a list of `SalesOrder` objects with optional filtering for sales orders that match a specified `OrderNumber` and sales orders that were modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of sales order lines
get.description: Gets a list of `SalesOrderLine` objects with optional filtering for only those sales order lines that belong to a specific `SalesOrder` by identifier and for sales order lines modified after a specified date.

get.summary: Get a list of sales order payments
get.description: Gets a list of `SalesOrderPayment` objects with optional filtering for only those sales order payments that belong to a specific `SalesOrder` by identifier and for sales order payments modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Supplier` objects with optional filtering for suppliers that were modified after a specified date.
Gets a list of `Warehouse` objects with optional filtering for warehouses that were modified after a specified date.

tags.name: Brand
tags.description: `Brand` objects are used to categorize and enhance information about a product.

tags.name: Category
tags.description: `Category` objects are used to segment products in to different hierarchical groups.

tags.name: Contact
tags.description: The `Contact` object holds data about an individual and is associated with a `Customer`.

tags.name: Customer
tags.description: The `Customer` object holds data about a customer's high level billing data.

tags.name: CustomerAddress
tags.description: The `Customer Address` object holds data about a customer's address. A customer may have multiple addresses.

tags.name: Employee
tags.description: The `Employee` object holds data about an employee.

tags.name: Product
tags.description: The `Product` object holds data about a specific product including categorization, part numbers, type, and pricing.

tags.name: ProductImage
tags.description: The `ProductImageModel` object a URL of an image for a specified product.

tags.name: ProductSupplier
tags.description: The `ProductSupplier` object holds data about what `Supplier`s are available for each `Product` and the associated cost of a `Product` if purchased from them.

tags.name: PurchaseOrder
tags.description: The `PurchaseOrder` object holds data about a purchase order placed within Kaseya Quote Manager. This object includes information related to the billing address, delivery address the supplier used, and status. Further information is available via `PurchaseOrderCost` and `PurchaseOrderLine`.

tags.name: PurchaseOrderCost
tags.description: The `PurchaseOrderCost` object holds data about a `PurchaseOrder`'s associated costs, including amounts and applicable taxes.

tags.name: PurchaseOrderLine
tags.description: The `PurchaseOrderLine` object holds data about a line item associated with a specific `PurchaseOrder`. This information includes the product purchased, quantity, costs, and taxes.

tags.name: Quote
tags.description: The `Quote` object holds data about a quote including any contact information, delivery address and costs, and status.

tags.name: QuoteLine
tags.description: The `QuoteLine` object holds data about a line item associated with a specific `Qoute`. This information includes the product purchased, quantity, recurring information, costs, and taxes.

tags.name: QuoteSection
tags.description: The `QuoteSection` object holds data about a section of an associated `Quote` and its type.

tags.name: SalesOrder
tags.description: The `SalesOrder` object holds data about a sales order placed within Kaseya Quote Manager. This object includes information related to the delivery address of the order, payment amounts, the customer, and contact information.

tags.name: SalesOrderLine
tags.description: The `SalesOrderLine` object holds data about a line item associated with a specific `SalesOrder`. This information includes the product, quantity, cost, recurring sale information, and taxes.

tags.name: SalesOrderPayment
tags.description: The `SalesOrderPayment` object holds data about payments made for an associated `SalesOrder`. This information includes the amount, type, and reference identifiers.

tags.name: Supplier
tags.description: The `Supplier` object holds data about a supplier of products for your Kaseya Quote Manager portal.

tags.name: Warehouse
tags.description: The `Warehouse` object holds data about the location of a product warehouse associated with your Kaseya Quote Manager portal.
